steps.cap: An AI chip is more than the chip itself. It sits in a package: the chips on a silicon base, and under them the substrate, which connects everything to the circuit board.
The connections on top are packed tight. The circuit board below is wired in millimeters. The substrate has to join the two.
The substrate does it in layers, built outward from a stiff core. Each layer carries the copper a little further out.

Stacked together, the layers fan the tight grid out to the board’s wide one. An AI chip needs about 18 layers, against six for a PC, and every layer is another chance for a flaw, which is what makes these substrates hard to build.
